representation: Exactly the existing AXSQ0009 region encoder, 86272 deployed matrix coefficients. No new inference opcode, pretraining, auxiliary data, optimizer state or memory facts in the genome. Batch Adam is train-only; no PyTorch dependency was installed or used.
training: Accumulate gradients at unchanged parameters for 32 sentences; divide by actual sentence count including final partial batch, clip full global averaged gradient norm to 1, then dense Adam beta1=.9 beta2=.999 epsilon=1e-8 with bias correction. No weight decay. Same per-sentence frequency balance and inverted input dropout. Rate linearly decays to 10% across the fixed 32 epochs. Mean-token objective gives total BIO weight one per sentence; sum-token objective gives one per word. Output, mixing and lexical vectors update together. Adam moments use f32, corrections use f64; parameters bounded as before. SGD arithmetic must remain byte-identical in controls0/1.
controls: Six fixed fits before new scores: online SGD sum/mean and two Adam rates crossed with sum/mean. Paired initial weights/shuffle/dropout seed shared; later weights differ as intended. This changes optimizer AND batch update schedule, not proof that Adam alone caused any effect. No recurrent/byte/auxiliary combination supported by this initial opt-in trainer.
preflight: Finite differences of every coordinate of a tiny full input/mixing/output/bias network; sum of two half-gradients at unchanged parameters. Scalar two-step Adam reference, global clip, cleared batch, rejected invalid gradients without parameter mutation, deterministic numeric roundtrip and new copied value. Not independent language proof.
selection: Consumed-development exact count, then deployed matrix coefficient count, then index. All results and failures retained. Development is adaptive across earlier studies, never a new reserve; reserved workers and original test untouched.
scope: No expansion of page/genome/input/work/receipt quotas. Training workspace has three f32 arrays (gradient and two moments) per coefficient, bounded independently at 500000 coefficients; these buffers are not inference residency. No claim of exponential learning, AGI, language comprehension, measured physical efficiency or M1 completion. All seven M1 gates remain mandatory.
